measures.name: Author-label mentions
measures.description: Retained author-label occurrence rows in the current mention-table filter context. Not resolved people, staff or unique publications. MentionKey uniqueness is a separate ingestion invariant.

measures.name: Author-label groups
measures.description: Distinct nonblank case-preserving author-label group keys in the current mention-table filter context. Labels are not resolved identities; groups are not additive across overlapping selections.

measures.name: Retained publications with author-label evidence
measures.description: Distinct nonblank retained publication keys in the current mention-table filter context. Includes keys absent from the current canonical table; use the canonical-match and key-gap measures to reconcile coverage.

measures.name: First-listed publications by author label
measures.description: Distinct publication keys whose retained author label is first-listed, intersecting existing mention-table filters. Author ordering is source evidence, not leadership, affiliation or identity confirmation.

measures.name: Last-listed publications by author label
measures.description: Distinct publication keys whose retained author label is last-listed, intersecting existing mention-table filters. Single-author works may be both first and last; these counts must not be added together.

measures.name: Canonical publications with author-label evidence
measures.description: Distinct current canonical keys also present in the selected retained author-label evidence. Honors filters on both tables without adding a relationship. This is publication evidence, not person identity.

measures.name: Canonical publications without retained author labels
measures.description: Current canonical keys with no retained author-label evidence. Honors canonical filters; ignores ordinary mention-table slicers to measure complete-table coverage. Row security still applies. Does not mean no authors.

measures.name: Retained author-label works outside canonical key domain
measures.description: Selected retained publication keys absent from the full canonical key domain. Ignores ordinary canonical filters to avoid false orphan counts for out-of-period works. Row security still applies; no records are removed.
